text:
Do not use a catheter valve when continuous free drainage is required—such as after certain urological procedures or with significant haematuria, clots, or debris—or when the patient has reduced bladder capacity or sensation, renal impairment or reflux risk, or cannot reliably understand and operate it because of cognitive impairment or poor dexterity. A catheter valve does not measure or record urine volume, so urine-volume recording is not a reason to restrict its use.
CONFIDENCE: 92
